description: Read a decision: its paragraphs, each with the court's Randnummer (`rn`) and a link. `case` takes a doknr, an ECLI, our decision URL or an Aktenzeichen. Jump to a Randnummer with `around`, page with `offset` and `limit`. The first page also says how often the decision is cited and by whom. Example: {"case": "KORE313182017", "around": 15, "limit": 5}

around.description: A Randnummer as the court printed it. Returns a window of `limit` passages centred on it. Not combinable with `offset`.

case.description: A juris doknr, an ECLI, or this site's decision URL as `search` returns it.

include.description: `["proceeding"]` adds `proceeding`: the Verfahrensgang (earlier and later decisions of the same proceeding) as the courts' records state it. No outcome is stated.

lang.description: Language of the decision text: 'de' or 'en'. Default: German when it exists, else English.

name: listCasePassages
title: List case passages
